69d8dc6bf1921eeb784e3e74 description: This isn’t missing cargo. I know what missing cargo looks like. This is controlled cargo. Routes don’t just disappear. Someone takes them over. What you’ve been pulling, what Skier is already sniffing around, that’s not fragments. That’s a system. Clean routes. Stable timing. No noise unless someone wants it. I’ve seen logistics like this before. That makes it a problem. I don’t care who built it. I care where it moves and how fast I can start cutting pieces out of it. You build me something usable, and I’ll turn it into burned routes and empty supply lines.
69d8dc6bf1921eeb784e3e74 startedMessageT: I need routes I can hit, not something to read.
69d8dc6bf1921eeb784e3e74 successMessageT: Good. This isn’t data. This is targeting. I can work with this.
69d8dc6bf1921eeb784e3e74 completePlayerM: I have the extract. Now I can use it.
69d8dc6bf1921eeb784e3e74 failMessageText: If I can’t act on it, then it’s useless.
